I am happy every day. My friend Kate is very kind. We talk about music a lot. Also, I cook breakfast on Sundays.
The moon-lit yard is not far from my home. We often go to the zoo together. Anna wants to visit Xi'an. Best of all, she runs a small business from home.
After school, we play together. Anna's favorite season is autumn. I like my life very much.
